sources.entry: Fider - Open platform to collect and prioritize feedback (alternative to UserVoice). (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Fider is an open-source feedback portal where users submit and vote on feature requests and suggestions, offered as a managed cloud service or self-hosted.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly promotional, so it gives limited technical detail. It describes Fider as a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions, aimed at letting customers voice needs so product teams can prioritize. It is offered as Fider Cloud, a fully managed hosted service run by the project's creators, or as a self-hosted install on your own servers and infrastructure. The README does not list specific features, installation steps, or the technology stack; those details would be in the linked docs. The awesome-selfhosted listing places it under Polls and Events, describes it as an alternative to UserVoice, and tags it MIT and Docker.
how_to_run: Self-host: follow the 'Learn how' link in the README (docs), since the README gives no install commands
notable: Offered both as a managed cloud service and as a free self-hosted install
Positioned as an open-source alternative to UserVoice
Focused on feature requests and prioritizing user suggestions
caveats: Self-hosting makes you responsible for maintenance, updates, and infrastructure
The README gives no concrete install or configuration steps; details are in external docs
Donations and sponsorship are encouraged to support development
